description: A shareable report for one FINISHED Monday-to-Sunday week, built from the other tools: workouts, sleep/HRV/recovery/steps (week median vs the user's own prior 28 days), training load, guided strength sessions, plan adherence and tag effects. `week` is the Monday (default: the last full week); an unfinished week, a non-Monday or an invalid date is refused. A failing section is null and explained in errors; one with too little data says 'insufficient data'. `markdown` is meant to be shared: no account id, token, workout key or file path, user text escaped; it does hold the plan goal, session titles and tag names, so read it before sharing. workouts.tss (sum of the sessions) can differ from load.weekTss (the load model's own figure); the markdown says so. Reads about 30 requests from Suunto. save: true also writes the markdown to ~/.suunto-mcp/reports/week-<Monday>.md (SUUNTO_REPORTS_DIR moves it; 0600): a different existing file is never replaced unless `overwrite: true` is also given (a refused save is saved.status 'refused', the report is still returned); `overwrite` without `save` is refused. Nothing is sent anywhere (demo mode: save stays in memory). Annotated not read-only (destructive only via overwrite: true) because save writes a local file.

overwrite.description: With save: replace a DIFFERENT existing file of that name; otherwise it is left and the save refused.

save.description: true: also write the markdown to the reports folder. Default false.

week.description: The Monday of the week, YYYY-MM-DD (default: the last full week). Must be finished.

name: get_weekly_report
title: Get the weekly report (optionally save it as a local markdown file)
